hashForge.title: Hash Forge
hashForge.subtitle: Generate MD5, SHA, bcrypt and Argon2 hashes, verify a hash, and encode or decode text.
hashForge.inputPlaceholder: Type or paste the text to hash…
hashForge.saltedNote: Password hashes use a random salt, so each run gives a different value — every one of them verifies.
hashForge.bcryptTruncated: bcrypt only uses the first 72 bytes of the text; the rest is ignored.
hashForge.empty: Pick algorithms and type some text — digests update as you type.
hashForge.verifyIntro: Paste the original text and a hash. Salted formats (bcrypt, Argon2, crypt) are checked directly; for plain hex digests every algorithm of that length is tried.
hashForge.unknownFormat: This does not look like a hash format Hash Forge knows.
hashForge.localOnly: Runs in your browser; the text is not sent to the server.
hashForge.crackNote: Runs offline against a wordlist only — for auditing your own weak passwords.
hashForge.crackNotFound: Not in the wordlist — no weak match.
hashForge.auditIntro: Rate a password and flag it when it matches the username or a common list.
hashForge.auditEmpty: Type a password to rate it.
hashForge.bruteTooBig: Too many combinations (limit {cap}). Narrow the character set or length.
hashForge.crackStopped: Stopped at the time limit — try a smaller range.
hashForge.limitAlgosHint: Leave empty to auto-detect by length. Ignored for salted hashes.

loadTest.title: Load Test
loadTest.subtitle: Send a capped burst of requests to one of your own sites and measure how it holds up.
loadTest.ownOnly: You can only test domains that belong to your account.
loadTest.noDomains: No domains are assigned to your account yet.
loadTest.caps: Capped at {r} requests, {c} at once, {s}s each.
loadTest.empty: Run a test to see latency and status codes.
loadTest.cappedNote: Stopped early at the time limit; results are partial.
